mapper.select: select org_id from sys_chat_scope_org where role_id = #{roleId} and deleted = 0

select t2.org_id from sys_user_role t1 inner join sys_chat_scope_org t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id inner join sys_role t3 on t1.role_id = t3.id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t1.deleted = 0 and t2.deleted = 0 and t3.deleted = 0 and t3.chat_scope = 4
